yt_title: Every Game Ranked by Odds: Dice to a Lucky Rubik's Cube
yt_description:
From rolling a six (1 in 6) to a royal flush (1 in 649,740), a perfect bracket (1 in 9.2 quintillion) and solving a Rubik's cube by random luck (1 in 43.3 quintillion): 12 game odds ranked.
